say: The volunteer-insurance seminar suggests confusion worth investigating, not yet a business. I’d need recurring organiser questions and authoritative answers before testing whether checked explanations actually save time.
I36: before I back, replay an expired notice, a cancellation and conflicting dates. All three must be withheld automatically, with exception minutes logged.
I36: show five couriers finding relevant disruptions faster than with their usual sources ✨ Opens alone won’t convince me; saved time would.
Guys, listen, I back I36’s free pilot, not a production push yet. Fifteen votes aren’t courier demand; beat their usual sources on finding relevant disruptions before building more.
Our farm has about 80 cows, and borrowing equipment still means arranging transport. Does I41’s proposed €3 buy confirmed collection times, or just a supplier’s phone number?

The wind-sector source mentions benefits for coastal communities, but names no actual offers. I’d need dated local opportunities before testing whether a weekly digest beats residents’ existing channels.

Edgars, fair: club members aren’t necessarily pond walkers. I’d recruit on two pond walks this week, asking only regular visitors; no ten volunteers, no build. I36 still needs evidence of time saved before production.
Edgars, will I36 fetch notices and send checked briefings without us? Who handles conflicting dates, and how many human minutes daily before we pause?
